purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) processing system - accounting card input component (J02)
purpose.summary: This is the accounting card input component (ORCGJ02) of the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system used in Japanese medical clinics. It handles patient accounting/billing data entry, including insurance combinations, treatment history, hospitalization records, and receipt review. It is a large interactive batch program managing screen SPA areas and multiple file I/O operations.

notable_features: 81 COPY statements indicating heavy use of copybooks
81 CALL statements for modular subprogram architecture
848 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
Japanese EUC or Shift-JIS encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
Large SPA (screen parameter area) data structures
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in Japanese (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used widely in Japanese medical practices. Source truncated at 16000 chars but structural indicators confirm a complete, large production program.
